name: mstack-epic
description: Details one epic for product and management people, from an approved product plan or from a description in chat. Interviews only what the detailed epic adds, then writes one document: outcome, who it is for, what is in and out, acceptance as plain statements, a measurable result, size, fixed limits, user stories and open questions for developers. It never edits the product plan and lists what changed. No code and no development steps. mstack-write-specs accepts the approved epic as its source. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Detail one epic so developers can write a spec from it.
interface.longDescription: Takes one epic of a product plan, or one described in chat, and interviews its product person in numbered rounds. It writes one detailed epic with acceptance statements a product person can check, a measurable result, fixed limits and open questions for developers. It never changes the product plan and lists every difference, has the document reviewed before approval, and links plan and epic inside an Obsidian vault.
